# Supplemental Materials

# Checking the model assumptions

```{r}
#| label: load-packages-data

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))

df <- read_csv("cleaned_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

```


```{r}
#| label: model-create-r
m <- lm(total_rides ~ `Full-Time` * `Car Access`, data = df)

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-model-assumptions
#| fig-cap: "Model assumptions check - Residuals vs Fitted, Normal Q-Q, Scale-Location, and Residuals vs Leverage plots"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

#make the figure 2x2
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

plot(m)

```
